C1350.title: Personal Laptop Infected by Monero Mining Trojan Leading to Long-Term CPU Resource Theft
C1350.summary: A cybersecurity student discovered abnormal CPU usage reaching 48% on a Windows laptop. Investigation revealed that attackers exploited the legitimate Microsoft AddInProcess.exe process to inject a Monero miner, connecting to the Nanopool mining pool for cryptocurrency mining.
